==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|Thanks for your help, both of you. It took a lot of guts and we appreciate it.|The clone trooper, to a [[Unidentified Tethan youngling|Tethan Human youngling]] and [[Peder]] in one adventure path in ''The Clone Wars: Decide Your Destiny: Tethan Battle Adventure''|<ref name="Tethan" />}}
